problem_text:
A logistics manager must select packages to load onto a cargo drone. The available packages are:
* Package 1: weight 46 kg, revenue 198 credits
* Package 2: weight 22 kg, revenue 242 credits
* Package 3: weight 42 kg, revenue 78 credits
* Package 4: weight 39 kg, revenue 274 credits
* Package 5: weight 6 kg, revenue 138 credits
* Package 6: weight 7 kg, revenue 62 credits
* Package 7: weight 18 kg, revenue 22 credits
* Package 8: weight 45 kg, revenue 82 credits
* Package 9: weight 40 kg, revenue 79 credits
* Package 10: weight 25 kg, revenue 116 credits
* Package 11: weight 37 kg, revenue 173 credits
* Package 12: weight 13 kg, revenue 225 credits
* Package 13: weight 33 kg, revenue 266 credits
* Package 14: weight 8 kg, revenue 296 credits
* Package 15: weight 7 kg, revenue 253 credits

The drone has a maximum payload capacity of 271 kg. Choose the set of packages that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this weight limit. Each package must be either fully loaded or left behind.
